title: Littoral invertebrates in 85 Swedish lakes followed about 0.5-0.9 of the spatial pH expectation in 1995-2022, mainly by abundance shifts; acid-lake phytoplankton shifts did not scale with pH change
abstract: We tested whether assemblages in Swedish lakes followed the chemical recovery from acid deposition as far as the spatial relation between lake pH and composition predicts. We used 101 national trend lakes with littoral and profundal invertebrates and phytoplankton (researchdata.se 2025-136) and independent SLU chemistry (2025-256). A community pH index used cross-fitted genus optima. We compared index changes from 1995-2004 to 2013-2022 with the spatial slope times the observed pH change. pH increased by 0.18 units in 32 acid lakes and by 0.05 in buffered lakes. For littoral invertebrates, the across-lake tracking ratio was 0.85 (95% interval 0.21 to 1.34), 0.66 (0.09 to 1.10) after removal of network-wide taxon changes, and 1.21 after a pH-noise correction; without the two lakes with the largest pH increase it was 0.54 (-0.13 to 1.13). The acid-minus-buffered test gave 1.32 (0.32 to 2.57), but it depended on the acid threshold. A raw acid-minus-buffered comparison gave 2.40, because common taxon changes (for example more Oligochaeta in all lakes) move low-pH and high-pH lake indices in opposite directions. The littoral shift came from abundance changes (fewer Leptophlebia, more Caenis); with presence weights it was not clear. Profundal ratios (0.5 to 0.9) had intervals that included 0 and 1. Phytoplankton in acid lakes shifted more than pH predicts (adjusted ratio 2.97, 1.32 to 6.67; less Gonyostomum, more diatoms), but lake pH change did not predict lake change (ratio near 0). Many phytoplankton labels changed in 2012-2014. Air temperature, precipitation, browning and the 2018 drought did not explain the deviations. Limitations: the record starts after much of the chemical recovery, pH contrasts are small, and the spatial target can include other lake differences. Source data stay external; code, aggregate results and figures are included.
